svg.text: Package leads below use the HED CIU32L071 LQFP48 pinout, not the different STM32L071 pinout and not PCB Pxx pad labels.
The MCU briefly removes drive, grounds one terminal
through Q2 or Q3, allows settling, then samples PB13.
Back-EMF indicates motor rotation. It does not directly
measure plunger position or motor current.
A slipping mechanism can keep the motor turning at
the end of travel. The replacement combines feedback
with bounded movement and back-off/return checks.
Exact D1/D2 part numbers and diode technology.
R3/R5, C6/C7 and the temperature sensor network.
Exact radio-module pads, display input pin and U4.
A complete manufacturer truth table for SA116L.
Semiware S8050 Rev A2.0: J3Y marking, B1/E2/C3.
connections are from the saved continuity checks.
